cards5.description: Strawberry Legs: Causes, Treatments & Tips to Prevent Them
cards5.text: Ever seen small dark spots on your legs that give your skin the appearance of the surface of a strawberry? Yep, that's what most people refer to as strawberry legs or strawberry skin. Don't panic, this condition is extremely common and completely treatable.

cards5.description: A Complete Guide to Dandruff Causes, Symptoms & Treatments
cards5.text: If you're reading this, you probably know more about dandruff than most persistent flakes, an itchy scalp and multiple failed “miracle” treatments. Dandruff isn’t a new issue and neither are the remedies. From home hacks to expensive formulas, the suggestions are endless.

cards5.description: Rosemary for Hair: Benefits, Types & Ways to Use Rosemary for Hair Growth
cards5.text: Rosemary for hair has made a serious comeback in recent years and for good reason. It’s one of those rare ingredients that’s been around for centuries, and now, even science is backing up what tradition always supported.

cards5.description: How to Fix an Oily Scalp Without Drying Out Your Hair?
cards5.text: The main reason for an oily scalp is the excessive production of sebum, a natural oil released by your sebaceous glands on your scalp. This oil is essential for protecting the scalp and keeping hair hydrated.
